lines.en: Hooves tap on fallen leaves
Steps dance like the wind
Paws move slowly, seeking beauty
Moving through the grass slowly
Piercing through the woods with grace
Hooves resound in the forest
Wandering on the quiet forest path
Walking on the forest floor under the trees
Elegantly walking on the soil
Hooves gently touch the ground
Along the creek bank, step by step.

lines.zh: 蹄子陷进软泥里又拔出来。
lines.en: My hooves sink into soft mud and pull free.
Standing by the tree, gazing far
Chewing grass leisurely
Standing still, quiet
Chewing cherry leaves, slowly.

lines.zh: 花木林的日光，晒得我想睡。
lines.en: Blossom grove sunlight makes me drowsy.
Relaxing, admiring the view
Resting on a branch for a moment
Sniffing the grass with a low head

lines.zh: 我耳朵转了一圈，风很轻。
lines.en: I turn an ear; the wind is light.
Napping in the shade

lines.zh: 耳朵转向声音来的地方。
lines.en: My ears swivel toward the sound.
Nibbling young shoots in the ferns.
Nose buried in the grass, sniffing.
Scraping my hooves on a fallen log.
Dozy on my feet, ears still up.
Head up, blank-eyed, still chewing.
Chewing cud slowly in the shade.
I shake the fallen leaves off my back.
Spotting the player, it runs away quickly
Noticing the player, it flees instantly
Avoids when the player approaches
Staring at the player, carefully escaping
Runs when it sees the player

lines.zh: 目光锁定玩家，迅速撤离
lines.en: Fixes its gaze on the player, then flees
Watching the player, it quickly escapes

lines.zh: 察觉玩家靠近，飞快逃走
lines.en: Escapes quickly when the player is near
Races away upon seeing the player
Rushes away when it spots the player

lines.zh: 隔着草丛，警惕地望着你。
lines.en: Through the grass, I watch you warily.
You crouched, so I stop hiding.
The deer whimpers in pain.
The deer mumbles in pain.
The deer moans in agony.
The deer cries in agony.
The deer groans in pain.
The deer whimpers weakly in pain.
The deer shudders in its whimpers.
The deer calls out in pain.
The deer moans and shudders.
The deer falls, moaning.

lines.zh: 鹿靠近你，好奇地看着你手中的苹果。
lines.en: Deer approaches you, curiously eyeing the apple in your hand.

lines.zh: 你喂它甜浆果，它慢慢靠近，变得信任。
lines.en: You feed it sweet berries, and it slowly approaches, becoming more trusting.

lines.zh: 鹿吃下花，欢快地跳跃起来。
lines.en: Deer munches the flower, bouncing happily.

lines.zh: 它用鹿角轻触地面，留下花朵印记。
lines.en: It touches the ground with its antler, leaving a flower imprint.

lines.zh: 鹿在你附近悠闲地吃着草莓。
lines.en: Deer munches on strawberries nearby.

lines.zh: 金苹果让鹿更加信任你。
lines.en: Golden apples make deer even more trusting.

lines.zh: 喂它苹果，它会复制花朵在地上。
lines.en: Feed it an apple, and it copies flowers on the ground.

lines.zh: 鹿在你周围欢快地跳跃。
lines.en: Deer bounces happily around you.

lines.zh: 鹿在温带森林中悠闲地吃着草。
lines.en: Deer grazes leisurely in the temperate forest.

lines.zh: 你喂苹果，它用鹿角轻触你。
lines.en: You feed it an apple, and it touches you with its antler.

lines.zh: 你试图接近鹿，却被它撞倒。
lines.en: You try to approach the deer, but it knocks you down.
Deer bumps into you, trying to run away.

lines.zh: 鹿在你周围奔跑，试图远离你。
lines.en: Deer runs around you, trying to stay away.

lines.zh: 你在鹿后面奔跑，试图捕捉它。
lines.en: You run after the deer, trying to catch it.

lines.zh: 你试图抓住鹿，但它用力撞开你。
lines.en: You try to grab the deer, but it shoves you away.

lines.zh: 鹿撞上障碍物，发出哀鸣。
lines.en: Deer collides with an obstacle, emitting a mournful cry.
Deer runs into a tree, trying to escape.

lines.zh: 鹿用鹿角撞击你，让你后退。
lines.en: Deer uses its antler to push you back.

lines.zh: 你在鹿的袭击中被撞倒。
lines.en: You are knocked down by the deer's charge.
Deer runs into you, but you dodge.
Deer approach each other, preparing to mate.

lines.zh: 鹿在草地上交配，显得很亲密。
lines.en: Deer mate on the grass, appearing very intimate.

lines.zh: 鹿的鹿角互相触碰，进行交配。
lines.en: Deer antlers touch as they mate.

lines.zh: 雌鹿发出交配时的叫声。
lines.en: Female deer makes a mating call.
Deer rub against each other, preparing to mate.

lines.zh: 雄鹿在雌鹿身上留下鹿角印记。
lines.en: Male deer leaves antler marks on the female.
Deer lick each other, preparing to mate.

lines.zh: 鹿在草丛中交配，显得很专注。
lines.en: Deer mate in the grass, looking very focused.
Deer snuggle after mating.

lines.zh: 雌鹿发出交配成功的叫声。
lines.en: Female deer makes a successful mating call.
Chews gently on a strawberry.
Eats an apple, savoring it.
Looks curiously at the flower in hand.

lines.zh: 享受着樱桃带来的甜蜜。
lines.en: Eats a cherry, savoring its sweetness.
Approaches player, stopping in its tracks.
Sniffs, decides not to pay attention.
Pleases with the sugary treat.
Hops closer to the player.
Eats the sweet berry.
Licks the apple.
Hears footsteps, quietly flees.

lines.zh: 察觉玩家接近，飞快奔跑。
lines.en: Detects player, sprints away.
Creeps closer, ready to hop.
Stares at the player, cautious.
Sniffs out danger.
Spots the player, runs away.
Detects player sneaking.
Dodges the player, seeking cover.
Hides at a distance, watching.
Notices the threat from the player.
I peek out first, then decide to run.
Butts the player with its horns.
Defends with its horns.
Hops up, trying to knock down the player.
Butts against the player's weapon.
Tries to lift the player with its horns.
Threatens with its horns.
Butts against the player's hand.
Butts to test the player's defenses.
Butts to uncover the player's equipment.

lines.zh: 蹄声踏破寂静，鹿角刮过树皮。
lines.en: Hooves break the silence, antlers scrape bark.

lines.zh: 鹿角碰撞，树叶纷飞，鹿已逃远。
lines.en: Antlers clash, leaves fly, the deer is gone.

lines.zh: 鹿蹄急促，冲向密林深处。
lines.en: Hooves quicken,奔向密林深处.

lines.zh: 鹿在林间疾驰，蹄声如雷。
lines.en: Deer dashes through the forest, hooves thundering.

lines.zh: 鹿角划破空气，树枝折断。
lines.en: Antlers slice air, branches snap.

lines.zh: 鹿群奔逃，蹄声连成一片。
lines.en: Deer flee, hooves pounding in unison.

lines.zh: 鹿用角推开障碍，轻巧跳跃。
lines.en: Deer push aside obstacles with antlers, leap lightly.
Deer dart, avoiding the pursuer.
Antlers collide, pushing back the attacker.
Deer work together, driving back the intruder.

lines.zh: 温带森林深处，鹿群悄然出现。
lines.en: Deers quietly appear in the temperate forest.
Deers forage in the forest.

lines.zh: 鹿栖息于森林的边缘地带。
lines.en: Deers rest at the forest edge.

lines.zh: 鹿群聚集在清澈的小溪旁。
lines.en: Deers gather by the clear stream.

lines.zh: 鹿在树荫下寻找阴凉之处。
lines.en: Deers seek shade under the trees.

lines.zh: 鹿群享受温带森林的宁静。
lines.en: Deers enjoy the peace of the temperate forest.

lines.zh: 鹿在柔软的草地上休息。
lines.en: Deers rest on soft grass.

lines.zh: 鹿群靠近，警惕地观察周围。
lines.en: Deers approach, watching their surroundings.

lines.zh: 鹿在树丛中嬉戏，享受自由。
lines.en: Deers play in the shrubs, enjoying their freedom.

lines.zh: 鹿群在林间穿梭，寻找新的栖息地。
lines.en: Deers move through the forest, seeking new homes.

lines.zh: 晨雾里，林边多了几只蹄印。
lines.en: In the morning mist, fresh hoofprints at the treeline.

lines.zh: 我落在橡树与野花之间。
lines.en: I come to rest among oaks and wildflowers.

lines.zh: 鹿被火焰烧伤，惨叫着奔跑。
lines.en: The deer runs in agony from the fire.

lines.zh: 鹿从高处摔下，惨叫不止。
lines.en: The deer cries in agony from the fall.

lines.zh: 鹿溺水后，发出绝望的哀鸣。
lines.en: The deer emits a despairing moan after drowning.

lines.zh: 鹿被爆炸震伤，哀叫着倒下。
lines.en: The deer cries in agony from the explosion.
The deer cries and falls from an arrow.

lines.zh: 鹿被魔法击中，哀叫着倒下。
lines.en: The deer cries in agony from magic.

lines.zh: 鹿饿得虚弱，哀叫着倒下。
lines.en: The deer cries in agony from starvation.

lines.zh: 鹿被雷击中，发出痛苦的哀鸣。
lines.en: The deer emits a painful moan from lightning.

lines.zh: 鹿跌入虚空，惨叫一声消失。
lines.en: The deer cries in agony and vanishes into the void.
